grid.storageMode: +0x20 signed32;1 selects RLE,all other values raw

contracts: Bounds include both ends. Outside leaves context pointer,gridActive,lastCell and decoded bytes unchanged.
CellIndex=width*floor(float32(x87((cameraZ-minZ)*scaleZ)))+floor(float32(x87((cameraX-minX)*scaleX))). Native does not clamp the cell at the upper endpoint.
Inside copies cell pointer to context+0x24 and sets global active according to nonnull pointer. Non-RLE mode aliases that pointer. Null RLE cell sets null pointer and active0 while preserving cache.
RLE nonnull cell always aliases global scratch. Equal cell index skips decode regardless of grid identity or source pointer. Cache invalidation is a caller/lifecycle obligation.

RLE header length=header>>2 (0..63). Tags0/1 fill00/ff; tags2/3 copy literal bytes. Valid zero-size headers consume a header and make no output progress. Native loops until output>=decodedByteCount; malformed overshoot/truncation has unsafe memory behavior.
Native RLE cache updates lastCell before decode; portable malformed-input rejection uses a guarded decode then commits the new cache key. Valid input behavior is retained.
